STUDY 058
Off-Shoulder Gown in the Garden
Rights check
Source: 24408.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight
golden-blonde hair stands on a garden path in front of a
stone colonnade. She wears a black off-shoulder gown
with a deep V neckline and a structured bodice, a
layered gold choker, and large gold drop earrings. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, late-afternoon
daylight, a palette of black, gold, and warm stone.
Classic and glamorous, in the style of a 1990s couture
show photograph.
Classic, glamorous, timeless
WORKING NOTES
- The off-shoulder neckline and gold jewelry define the
look.
- Add 'mid-stride' for a runway walk.
